page.layout: Three columns of Hebrew index entries with page numbers, read top to bottom: left column, middle column, right column. Running head at top centre. Catchword at the lower right of the right column. Left-edge strip is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: ר הכית , latissime sumptum, 5. strictius sumptum. 11
מסכה 151. in Ezechielis templo. 166. confertur cū הורדת המ' [?] 165. 166.
מעויכה [?] 159 de מעויכה conciliatio authorum, ibid.

page.notes: Hebrew entries are copied as far as legible; several words are doubtful and marked [?], especially the column-top and section-letter glyphs, the Hebrew after "cū" and "ibid." lines, and words such as מנוך, מגוסח, נגידי, נתתי and סגן. The line "& 34. etiã ambulacrum erat. 146" stands at the top of the right column and may continue an entry from the middle column; it is kept as printed. No page number is printed on this page. Section letters are read from the glyphs and the second-column letter is doubtful.
